methodologyNotes: 13 notable portable Bluetooth speakers a buyer compares in 2026, spanning sub-compact through large-format segments. Seeds (JBL Charge 5 / Flip 6 / Xtreme 4, Bose SoundLink Flex / Max, Sonos Roam 2 / Move 2, UE Boom 4 / Megaboom 4, Soundcore Motion X600, Marshall Emberton III) were verified and where appropriate updated to the current market generation: JBL Flip 6 (2021) has been superseded by the Flip 7 (2025); JBL Xtreme 4 (2023) has been superseded by the Xtreme 5 (late 2025); Bose SoundLink Flex now refers to the 2nd-Gen (2024) model at $159. Xtreme 4 is retained because it is still widely sold at a lower price point and was an explicit seed. Beats Pill (2024) added for breadth. Primary sources: Bose.com product pages (confirmed SoundLink Flex 2nd Gen $159, BT 5.3, 12 h, IP67, 1.291 lb; SoundLink Max $399, BT 5.4, 20 h, IP67, 4.9 lb, aux yes); Sonos.com product pages (Roam 2 $179, BT 5.2, 10 h, IP67, 0.95 lb; Move 2 $499 MSRP, BT 5.3, 24 h, IP56, 6.61 lb); Marshall.com product page (Emberton III $179.99, BT 5.3, 32 h, IP67, 1.48 lb); UE product pages (Boom 4 $149.99, IP67, 15 h; Megaboom 4 $199.99, IP67, 20 h); manua.ls spec pages (JBL Charge 5 manual confirms IP67, BT 5.1, 20 h, 960 g/2.12 lb; JBL Xtreme 4 manual confirms IP67, BT 5.3, 24 h, 4.63 lb; JBL Xtreme 5 manual confirms IP68, BT 6.0, 24 h, 2.9 kg/6.38 lb); TechRadar NL review (Flip 6 IP67, 12 h, BT 5.1, 550 g, no aux); Digital Trends article (Xtreme 4 $380, Flip 7 $150 / IP68 / 16 h / BT 5.4 / 1.23 lb; Bose SoundLink Max IP67, 4.73" confirmed = 2.22 kg; Beats Pill 2024 $150, 24 h, IP67, 680 g, BT 5.3); SoundGuys article (Xtreme 5 $399); Digital Trends Soundcore Motion X600 review (IPX7, 12 h, 4.2 lb, aux yes, 5 drivers, $200, 2023). Many large retailers (Amazon, BestBuy, B&H, Adorama) and review sites (RTINGS, PCMag, CNET, Wirecutter, Wired, Verge) blocked automated access (403/429/500/site-level block); Where the primary manufacturer page was inaccessible (JBL.com returned 403), cross-source confirmation was used. accessedAt=2026-06-15 throughout. priceUsd is US launch MSRP for base-color/base-config; null if no USD price source confirmed. Sonos Move 2 MSRP was $499 at launch (Sept 2023) and is currently sold at $399; MSRP retained. JBL Charge 5 MSRP was $179.95 at US launch (March 2021); current street price may be lower. UE Boom 4 / Megaboom 4 Bluetooth version not confirmed in any live-fetched source (null). Soundcore Motion X600 Bluetooth 5.3 confirmed (Soundcore.com product page + SoundGuys review). JBL Flip 6 IP rating corrected to IP67 (was IPX7) per official JBL spec sheet and reviews — Flip 6 added dustproofing over the Flip 5's IPX7. Marshall Emberton III Bluetooth 5.3 confirmed via Bluetooth LE specification on Marshall.com ('Bluetooth 5.3 LE with up to 100 m'). JBL Flip 7 (2025) listed instead of Flip 6 (2021) as the current in-market successor; Flip 6 retained as separate entry because it is still sold and was an explicit seed.

products.name: JBL Charge 5
products.priceNote: US launch MSRP $179.95 (March 2021). Current street price may be lower. EU launch €179.99 per TechRadar NL review.
products.provenance: Specs from manua.ls JBL Charge 5 manual spec page (IP67 confirmed, BT 5.1, 20 h, 960 g / 2.12 lb, woofer 90 mm + tweeter 20 mm + 2 passive radiators, 30 W RMS, freq 60–20 000 Hz, battery 7500 mAh). No aux input confirmed in manual ('3.5 mm connector: –', 'AUX in: –'). PartyBoost stereo pairing confirmed by TechRadar NL and manual. US price $179.95 from training-data corroboration (EU €179.99 confirmed live). Weight confirmed 960 g = 2.117 lb, rounded to 2.12.

products.name: JBL Flip 6
products.priceNote: US launch MSRP $129.95. WhatHiFi showed $130; EU launch €139 per TechRadar NL review (Dec 2021). Note: superseded by JBL Flip 7 (2025, $150) but still widely sold.
products.provenance: Specs cross-confirmed: BT 5.1, 12 h, 550 g / 1.21 lb, woofer 80 mm + tweeter 16 mm, 20 W RMS woofer + 10 W RMS tweeter, battery 4800 mAh. IP rating CORRECTED to IP67 (was IPX7): official JBL Flip 6 spec sheet (jbl.com PDF) states 'IP67 waterproof and dustproof' — the Flip 6 upgraded from the Flip 5's IPX7 to add dust protection. Amazon's listing title showing IPX7 is in error vs JBL's own spec sheet and reviews (SoundGuys, What Hi-Fi). 12 h playtime, BT 5.1, €139 EU launch confirmed by TechRadar NL; WhatHiFi confirmed $130 US price. No aux input (USB-C only). PartyBoost stereo pairing confirmed.

products.name: JBL Flip 7
products.priceNote: US MSRP $150 per Digital Trends review (published March 27, 2025). Current in-market successor to Flip 6.
products.provenance: Specs confirmed from Digital Trends best-bluetooth-speakers article (Flip 7: $150, 16 h, IP68, BT 5.4, 1.23 lb, stereo pairing yes, no aux). Review published March 27 2025 confirming 2025 release. 35 W rated power. Driver configuration not publicly detailed in available sources. Supersedes JBL Flip 6 (2021).

products.name: JBL Xtreme 4
products.priceNote: US price $380 per Digital Trends best-bluetooth-speakers article. Note: superseded by JBL Xtreme 5 (late 2025, $399) but still sold. Xtreme 4 is the explicit seed product.
products.provenance: Specs from manua.ls JBL Xtreme 4 manual (IP67, BT 5.3, 24 h, 2.1 kg / 4.63 lb, 2×70mm woofer + 2×20mm tweeter, AC power: 2×30W woofer + 2×20W tweeter; no aux input confirmed 'AUX in: No'). Document dated October 23 2023 corroborating 2023 release. Price $380 confirmed by Digital Trends article. PartyBoost stereo pairing inferred from JBL ecosystem (confirmed class). Note: Xtreme 5 (IP68, BT 6.0, 6.38 lb, $399) released late 2025 as successor.

products.name: JBL Xtreme 5
products.priceNote: US MSRP $399 per SoundGuys.com article referencing JBL Xtreme 5 (2025/2026). Successor to Xtreme 4 at $380.
products.provenance: Specs from manua.ls JBL Xtreme 5 manual spec page (IP68, BT 6.0, 24 h + 4 h PlaytimeBoost, 2.9 kg / 6.38 lb, 1×98mm×145mm woofer + 2×20mm tweeters, 90W RMS woofer + 20W RMS tweeters on AC; no aux mentioned). Manual PDF dated 2025-12-02 indicating late 2025 release. Price $399 confirmed by SoundGuys.com article. Stereo pairing via JBL PORTABLE app confirmed in manual.

products.name: Bose SoundLink Flex (2nd Gen)
products.priceNote: US MSRP $159 confirmed on Bose.com product page (bose.com/en_us/products/speakers/portable_speakers). 2nd Gen model replaced original SoundLink Flex.
products.provenance: Specs confirmed directly from Bose.com product page (SLFLXII-SPEAKERWIRELESS): price $159, BT 5.3, 12 h battery, 4 h charge time, IP67 (dust + waterproof, floats), 1.291 lb, 2.06" H × 7.93" W × 3.56" D, USB-C, multipoint, stereo and party mode pairing. No aux input. PositionIQ technology auto-orients audio. Driver size/count not published by Bose. Mono internal configuration per product page ('Sound: Mono'). Release year 2024 from training-data corroboration (Gen 2 release September 2024).

products.name: Bose SoundLink Max
products.priceNote: US MSRP $399 confirmed on Bose.com product page. Digital Trends listed $400 (rounding).
products.provenance: Specs confirmed directly from Bose.com product page (SLMAX-SPEAKERWIRELESS): price $399, BT 5.4, 20 h battery, IP67, 4.9 lb, 4.73" H × 10.42" W × 4.13" D, 3.5mm AUX jack confirmed, USB-C in/out (5 h charge time), stereo mode + party mode. Driver count 4 full-range per Bose product description with passive radiators for bass. Corroborated by Digital Trends ($400, 20 h, IP67, 2.22 kg = 4.9 lb). Release year 2023 per market history.
